page.layout: One page: heading "Kalendarium Julianum." and "FEBRUARIUS" at the top; below them one table with six columns (Aurei num., Dies mensis, Litterae, day name, Dies collecti in anno communi, Dies collecti in anno bissextili); the printed page number 162 at the top left; "MAR." at the bottom right, which is the catchword of the next month.
page.notes: The Aurei numbers are printed in the first column only beside some days; blank cells are left empty. The final "60" appears only in the bissextili column, below the last row. Some Roman numerals in the day column are partly worn (e.g. "III" and "XIII") but read as printed.
